title: Assemblies
subtitle: Summon owners, take attendance, vote by permillage, and record the minutes.
emptyHint: Schedule an ordinary or extraordinary meeting for a condominium.
confirmDelete: Delete this assembly? This cannot be undone.

notice.legalMin: Portuguese law requires at least {days} days’ written notice.

detail.sendBlockedNotice: Schedule the meeting at least {days} days from today before sending.
detail.closeBlockedQuorum: Quorum is required to close and record resolutions.
detail.closedHint: This assembly is closed. Resolutions are locked.
detail.draftHint: Finish the agenda, then send the summons with at least {days} days’ notice.
detail.summonedHint: Owners have been summoned. Open the session on the meeting day to take attendance and vote.
detail.sessionHint: Record who is present, vote each agenda item by permillage, then write the minutes.

summons.title: Summons & legal notice
summons.bodyHint: The agenda must be in the convocatória. A second-call clause is included by default.
summons.willShort: Only {days} days from today — below the {min}-day legal minimum.
summons.legalOk: Legal notice met ({days} days before the meeting).
summons.legalShort: Only {days} days’ notice. The legal minimum is {min} days (art. 1432.º CC).

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.empty: Add the ordem de trabalhos before sending the summons.
agenda.locked: The agenda is locked after the summons is sent.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.notMet: No quorum on first call — use second call (those present).
attendance.secondCall: Second call: those present may deliberate.
attendance.proxyRequired: Choose who represents this owner — otherwise they do not count for quorum or votes.
attendance.none: No voting owners on this building’s fractions.

voting.title: Votes by permillage
voting.needQuorum: Quorum is required before votes count toward a valid deliberation.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.placeholder: Record the discussion, votes, and approvals. The acta is the legal memory of the meeting.
minutes.required: Write the minutes before closing the assembly.

resolutions.title: Resolutions
resolutions.empty: Resolutions appear when the assembly is closed.

errors.assemblyLocked: This step is locked for the current status.
errors.agendaRequired: Add at least one titled agenda item before sending the summons.
errors.summonsRequired: Send the summons before opening the session.
errors.noticeTooShort: Portuguese law requires at least 10 days’ written notice before the meeting.
errors.notInSession: Open the session before closing it.
errors.quorumRequired: Quorum is required before votes count and before closing.
